focus: 请求敏感信息识别、发送前自动脱敏、风险登记

architecture.baseline: v0.1.1 Python/aiohttp Provider / API KEY / Ops
architecture.mode: synchronous pre-forward local protection; not asynchronous after-the-fact auditing
architecture.gate: provider transport accepts only SanitizedRequest produced by completed privacy validation; cannot reuse original raw bytes on exception; upstream socket creation only after authorization
architecture.response: upstream response and SSE streaming unchanged; no output safety review this release

scope.accounts: all configured accounts; no silent unprotected account routing
scope.models: arbitrary model/version strings; model names not used as privacy allowlist
non_goals: automatic restoration of secrets in model output
scope.limits: unlabelled arbitrary passwords/names cannot be guaranteed; addresses/ID formats can false-positive; demonstrate specific supported patterns, evaluate recall and precision before release

policy.disable_category: explicit confirmation listing lost coverage required; categories disabled apply only to new request snapshots; not a global failure bypass
policy.custom_fields: exact case-insensitive ASCII identifiers2..40 chars, max32; field matching in nested JSON and labelled config text; no plaintext secret values and no arbitrary regex stored
policy.revision: CAS expected_revision; atomic save/activate;409 reload; in-flight policy and rule versions immutable
policy.activation_failure: reject new protected requests, no fallback to unvalidated configuration

request_inspection.paths: support standard POST model invocation endpoint aliases configured at provider layer; unknown callable endpoint fail closed, no provider-model whitelist
request_inspection.assembly: fully read/decode before first upstream request; bounded body across transfer chunks and UTF8 boundaries; reject duplicate JSON keys and non-finite numbers; decoded strings scanned once; invalid JSON/encoding refused
request_inspection.scope: all user-controlled request string values including system/instructions/messages/input, nested tool arguments/results when presented as text or string leaves; no tool execution or semantic chain reconstruction
request_inspection.structural: model/role/type/tool names/IDs and structural keys are scanned but not rewritten; if sensitive matches here reject rather than break tool routing; protect numerics/bools and schema types; sensitive numeric credential fields reject pending typed adaptation
request_inspection.unknown_shapes: unknown textual JSON fields recursively inspected; opaque/encrypted/base64 strings and image/audio/file parts or references which cannot be inspected are rejected when detected, not represented as checked; no promise to detect all obfuscation
request_inspection.multimodal: reject multimodal body/attachments/files or references, WS, unsupported encodings/protocols; no fallback original forwarding; errors name coverage limitation, not model incompatibility
request_inspection.routing_headers: user-supplied URL query and nonessential passthrough headers cannot bypass inspection. Preserve only documented safe protocol headers (content-type, accept, anthropic-version, bounded beta flags) after value validation; reject unexpected secret-bearing headers/query; strip cookies and caller auth before trusted Provider injection. Original path never echoed in errors/logs. No downstream arbitrary header passthrough in protected mode.
request_inspection.provider_auth: existing stored Provider credentials remain separate trusted egress auth; never scan them as user content and never include in privacy metadata
request_inspection.limits: max depth32, max string leaves4096, bounded scanner operations, per-request max bytes; no unbounded decode/decompress or recursive nested-code execution

redaction.method: detect candidate spans, normalize overlaps, build request-local value map, replace only permitted string paths, then validate request
redaction.precedence: whole private key / full connection URI first, longest overlapping span next, deterministic rule priority ties
redaction.consistency: identical observed original values share placeholder across all in-scope string leaves within one request, no cross-request identity table; labelled matches cause identical other occurrences to be replaced too
redaction.placeholders: [类别_N] ; reserve existing literal placeholder names before generating, no collision with user content; no equality proof across requests
redaction.preservation: request structure and ordinary text preserved; new Content-Length and content-type; remove stale content digest/signature headers; preserve stream/options/numbers/bools/tool routing fields; normalization of JSON whitespace permitted
redaction.verification: all recognized sensitive original spans removed; new placeholders excluded from residual test; reparse and compare structure/unchanged fields before egress; unknown secrets not claimed absent
redaction.no_restore: mapping destroyed after request; upstream response placeholders are not restored to secrets
redaction.error: replace/residual/structural failures block request; never bypass

failure.semantics: no upstream request for any preprocessing failure; return stable code plus gateway request_id, no original fragments; not HTTP200 mock success

execution.buffering: request admission acquires max32 slots/global32MiB; bounded64KiB default per-request; no sleeping holding excess buffers; body read deadline15s returns408
execution.worker: CPU scanning on bounded worker executor outside aiohttp event loop; deadline monitored by parent; expired work may finish but cannot obtain egress authorization; no auto request replay
execution.cancel: cancel or worker late result discards buffer and authorization; release slots exactly once; no original request retry
execution.risk_write: redacted request must commit minimal decision+findings before upstream open; store failure blocks; blocked requests attempt metadata write best-effort because egress already denied; ordinary unmatched request no risk row, only non-content counters
execution.forward_state: authorized -> forwarding -> completed/upstream_failed/client_cancelled/interrupted; immutable privacy decision independent; zero claim of upstream success from redaction result
execution.restart: mark historical forwarding interrupted; no replay and no original reconstruction; ephemeral raw bytes lost; durable records remain

data.database: separate privacy.sqlite WAL on existing persistent data volume; small serialized writes before authorization; no raw request storage
finding: safe_path structural path with arbitrary user keys normalized to [field]
never_store: raw model name copied from payload
data.feedback: append-only enum correct/false_positive; no free-text, no auto allowlist
data.privacy: minimal metadata may still describe use; trusted-local token protection, file permissions0600; DB backups contain metadata only; worker errors use enums, stack traces must not include content
data.memory: do not claim Python/JS secure zeroization; clear references and bound lifetime, avoid core dumps and debug payload logging

retention.read: filter expired at query time; background purge60s
retention.shorten: min(old_expiry,created_at+new_period) for existing rows; current policy updates cleanup atomically
retention.cascade: findings/feedback/preview references cleared; operation metadata only with count, no contents
retention.delete: preview fixed terminal IDs excluding in-flight forwarding; max10000; token actor+policy_revision+ids expires60s single-use; confirm rechecks transaction,410 expiry409 revision conflict; new arrivals never included

api.all_routes: existing trusted-local Host/Origin boundary + X-TraceMason-Token including GETs; no remote multiuser auth claim
api.preview: explicit local-only POST, user text transmitted only to local service, no model/detector request; returns transformed request and safe findings with Cache-Control:no-store; request logs disabled; raw body not reflected; policy current revision required
api.record_preview: explicit record_result default false; prototype checkbox-style test action records only safe risk metadata, source=validation distinct from gateway
api.query: filter action/category/account/source/since/until/id; same predicate summary/list/export, page<=100; unknown latency null
api.export: JSON metadata only max10000/20MiB;413 narrow scope; no original fields ever
api.body_sensitive: preview response contains outgoing redacted request; not assumed secret-free against unknown rules, must never persist it automatically

prototype.engine: local rule-based demonstrator actually scans supplied text; no preset risk decision
prototype.persistence: only safe policy identifiers and risk metadata; raw input/output/map current test page only; switch page/reload discards
prototype.tested_accuracy: supported fixture patterns only, no universal recall claim
limitations: no server auth and durable DB integration
browser does not enforce real network deadlines
not all protocol/header/encoding edge cases implemented in browser

field_mapping.risk.account: API Risk.account_id_snapshot resolved through configured catalog
field_mapping.risk.source: fixture is review-only; validation maps to API validation
field_mapping.risk.forward_state: all prototype records represent no actual upstream call; production records distinguish authorized/forwarding/completed/errors

reference.sub2api: borrow configuration/event/delete interaction patterns; asynchronous audit engine not used as egress protection
reference.new_api: existing Provider auth/url reference only; no protocol conversion imposed
reference.backup: old observation/retention insights only; no original-content persistence reused or migration claimed
